$Comment: The Objective Book. Using it opens the shared menu on Quests: a list of tabs down the left with this server's quests, achievements, the Almanac and boss records, plus any tabs another mod adds, with per-player progress; a player can take on an offered quest or collect a finished one there. Players can also open the same menu with /ziggui. Nothing hands the book out on its own: give one with /give <player> Ziggfreed_Objective_Book --quantity=1 (the count is read ONLY from --quantity, a bare number after the id is ignored), or author it as a quest, shop, or loot reward. The art is the vanilla brown grimoire; point Icon / Model / Texture somewhere else to reskin it, or override this file by id to retune anything here.
